samples.summary: Todo checklist is entirely unchecked, but the implementation it describes is already present in the tree (and matches this PR).
samples.evidence: docs/tasks/active/20260811-cli-error-envelope-command-todo.md lines with `- [ ] formatter.ts: drop null, 2; add an optional command parameter...`, `- [ ] Add a commandPath(cmd) helper...`, `- [ ] Thread this ... at every outputError call site`, `- [ ] cli.ts: capture the running command with a preAction hook`. All of these already exist verbatim in the working tree: packages/cli/src/output/formatter.ts has `commandPath()` (line 58) and `errorEnvelope`/`outputError` using single-line JSON with an optional `command` param; packages/cli/src/cli.ts registers `program.hook('preAction', ...)` (line 61); packages/cli/src/commands/docs.ts calls `outputError(e, this)` at all 8 sites. The accompanying `-lessons.md` file (paired per docs/tasks/active/README.md convention) is written in retrospective, completed-work voice ("Every outputError call site already lives inside a commander action... threading this needed no signature plumbing"), confirming the work is done — so the todo's unchecked boxes and open 'Plan'/'Acceptance criteria' sections are stale from the moment this PR lands them, which could mislead a reader scanning `docs/tasks/active/` for genuinely pending work.

samples.summary: If the task is in fact complete (as the lessons file and the matching code suggest), the pair should probably be archived via `pnpm tasks:archive` rather than added directly to `docs/tasks/active/`, per the convention stated in `docs/tasks/active/README.md` ('completed task pairs' move to `tasks/archive/YYYY/MM/`).

The new pair (20260811-cli-error-envelope-command-todo.md / -lessons.md) reads as a completed task (lessons file describes finished work, checked against code) yet was added to active/ with an unfinished-looking todo checklist instead of archive/.
